1.title: Grammar Auction: impossible, irregular, misunderstand
1.stage: YANGI MAVZU (prefiks jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Prefiksli so'z to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish: im- (b/m/p oldida), ir- (r), il- (l), in-, dis-, mis-; prefiks so'z turkumini o'zgartirmasligini tekshirish (be + unemployed — sifat).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz ta'lim mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gapdagi prefiksli so'z to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: to'g'ri prefiksni aytib, qoidani ham tushuntirishi kerak (masalan: 'r oldida ir- → irregular').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: It is impossible to learn 500 new words in one day.
items.why: possible p bilan boshlanadi → im-: impossible.

items.s: Her attendance is unregular, so the tutor is worried.
items.fix: Her attendance is irregular, so the tutor is worried.
items.why: r oldida inkor prefiksi ir-: irregular.

items.s: Many undergraduates feel overworked before their final exams.
items.why: over- = ortiqcha: overworked (haddan tashqari ko'p ishlagan, charchagan).

items.s: Selling fake diplomas is inlegal in Uzbekistan.
items.fix: Selling fake diplomas is illegal in Uzbekistan.
items.why: l oldida inkor prefiksi il-: illegal.

items.s: In many countries, teachers are still underpaid.
items.why: under- = kam, yetarli emas: underpaid (kam haq to'langan).

items.s: I disunderstood the lecturer's question and gave the wrong answer.
items.fix: I misunderstood the lecturer's question and gave the wrong answer.
items.why: 'Noto'g'ri' ma'nosi — mis-: misunderstand (dis- emas).

items.s: Being bilingual is a real advantage when you look for a job.
items.why: bi- = ikki: bilingual (ikki tilli).

items.s: My cousin graduated last year, but he is still unemploy.
items.fix: My cousin graduated last year, but he is still unemployed.
items.why: be dan keyin SIFAT kerak: unemployed. Prefiks turkumni o'zgartirmaydi.

items.s: Our university runs an international exchange programme with universities in South Korea.
items.why: inter- = orasida: international (xalqaro).

items.s: Two of my answers in the test were uncorrect.
items.fix: Two of my answers in the test were incorrect.
items.why: correct so'zining inkori in- bilan yasaladi: incorrect.

items.s: Non-native teachers can be excellent IELTS tutors.
items.why: non- = emas: non-native teacher — ingliz tili ona tili bo'lmagan ustoz.

items.s: Copying answers from a classmate is unhonest.
items.fix: Copying answers from a classmate is dishonest.
items.why: honest so'zining inkori dis- bilan yasaladi: dishonest.

1.title: Board Game: un-, im-, re-, mis- and more
1.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
1.goal: Prefiks qo'shib inkor va yangi ma'noli so'z yasash (un-, in-/im-/ir-/il-, dis-, re-, mis-, over-/under-, bi-, inter-, co-), xato prefikslarni tuzatish va ta'lim mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: prefiksli so'zni aytadi yoki u bilan TO'LIQ gap tuzadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: prefiks to'g'rimi (im- / ir- / il- qoidasi), ma'no mosmi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk' va 'Ask' kataklarida kamida 1 ta prefiksli so'z ishlatilishi shart.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

1.title: Dominoes: prefix word ↔ meaning
1.stage: Grammatika mustahkamlash — 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichida, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Prefiksli so'zni (impossible, misunderstand, underpaid, bilingual, co-educational…) uning inglizcha ta'rifi bilan ulash; prefiks ma'nosini eslash: in-/im-/ir-/il-, dis-, mis-, re-, pre-, over-/under-, bi-, co-, semi-, non-.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi prefiksli so'zning ta'rifi qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.
Prefiks ma'nosidan foydalaning: mis- = noto'g'ri, re- = qayta, pre- = oldin, under- = kam, over- = ortiqcha, co- = birga, semi- = yarim, bi- = ikki.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('Impossible means…'); ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: impossible
cannot happen or be done
irregular
not happening at normal or fixed times
illiterate
unable to read or write
misunderstand
understand something in the wrong way
rewrite
write something again, usually better
pre-school
for children too young for primary school
underpaid
getting too little money for your work
overestimate
think something is bigger or better than it is
international
between two or more countries
bilingual
able to speak two languages very well
co-educational
where boys and girls study together
semi-skilled
having some training, but not full training
disagree
have a different opinion
underachieve
do less well than you are able to
non-native speaker
someone who speaks a language that is not their first

1.title: Taboo: education words
1.stage: Essential Words 1 (CORE 20) lug'ati o'tilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Ta'lim mavzusidagi so'zlarni (curriculum, tuition fees, scholarship, peer, plagiarism, vocational…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda bugungi prefiksli so'zni to'g'ri ishlatsa (impossible, international, disagree, unemployed…) — jamoaga +1 qo'shimcha ball.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has misunderstood a teacher
1.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Prefiksli so'zlar (misunderstand, rewrite, re-sit, bilingual, oversleep, impossible, underprepared) bilan to'g'ri savol tuzish va o'qish tajribasi haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Have you ever had to rewrite an essay?'). Prefiksli so'z savolda albatta qatnashadi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

1.title: Speaking cards: education with prefixes
1.stage: Sinf mashqlaridagi juftlikdagi speaking mashqi o'rniga yoki dars oxirida (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Ta'lim mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida 3–4 gapli javob berish va javobda prefiksli so'zlarni (impossible, unfair, disagree, underestimate, irresponsible…) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (IELTS uslubi).
Javobda kamida 2 ta prefiksli so'z ishlatiladi: kartadagi so'z + o'zidan yana bittasi (unfair, impossible, disagree…).
Tinglovchi prefiksli so'zlarni sanaydi: to'g'ri ishlatilgan har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Have you ever misunderstood a teacher's instructions? What happened?
Is it impossible to get into a good university without a private tutor? Why / why not?
Some people think school uniforms are unnecessary. Do you agree or disagree? Why?
Do you think teachers are underpaid? How could schools keep good teachers?
Would you like to join an international exchange programme? Where would you go and why?
Is it important to be bilingual or even multilingual today? How many languages do you speak?
Why do some clever students underachieve at school? Give two reasons.
Some people say distance learning is ineffective. Do you agree? Why / why not?
Why is plagiarism unacceptable at university? What should happen to students who copy?
Should pre-school education be compulsory for all children? Why / why not?
Describe an unforgettable lesson. What made it special?
Do young people underestimate vocational education? Why / why not?
Have you ever had to rewrite or redo a piece of work? How did you feel?
What makes a teacher unpopular with students?
Is it irresponsible to take a gap year before university? Why / why not?
Do students today overuse their phones in class? What should schools do?

1.title: Sentence Race: prefixes in education
1.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa)
1.goal: Prefiksli so'zli gaplarda (misunderstood, re-sit, overestimate, interdisciplinary, underachieve, unaffordable…) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish va prefiksning ma'nosini tushuntirish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball; gapdagi prefiksli so'zning ma'nosini aytsa (masalan: 'underachieve — imkoniyatidan past natija') yana +1 ball.
Keyin jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: I misunderstood the question, so I got it wrong.
Copying other students' essays is dishonest.
Can you re-sit the final exam if you fail?
Our mentor never discourages us when we make mistakes.
It is impossible to rewrite a long essay in ten minutes.
Many students overestimate their chances of getting a scholarship.
Interdisciplinary research connects biology and computer science.
Plagiarism is unacceptable at universities all over the world.
Why do some gifted students underachieve at school?
Tuition fees are unaffordable for many families in our region.

1.title: Quiz Board: prefixes and education
1.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
1.goal: Prefikslar (inkor shakllari, ma'nosi, xatoni tuzatish) va ta'lim lug'atini o'yin shaklida takrorlash; 'Say it!' bo'limida prefiksli so'z bilan og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim), har birida 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida to'liq gap aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

2.title: Grammar Auction: happiness, carefully, environmentalist
2.stage: YANGI MAVZU (suffiks jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
2.goal: Suffiksli so'zning to'g'ri turkumi va imlosini ajratish: -ness (y → i), -ful (bitta l), -ly (-al + -ly = -ally), -ist (odam), -tion, -able; gapga kerakli turkum (ot / sifat / ravish) qo'yilganini tekshirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz atrof-muhit mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: suffiksli so'z to'g'ri turkumda va to'g'ri yozilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: to'g'ri so'zni harflab aytib, turkumini ham aytishi kerak (masalan: 'pollution — ot').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Plastic bags are harmful to sea animals.
items.why: harm + -ful = harmful (sifat, bitta l).

items.s: My uncle plants trees every spring — he is a real environmental.
items.fix: My uncle plants trees every spring — he is a real environmentalist.
items.why: Odamni -ist yasaydi: environmentalist. environmental — sifat.

items.s: Recyclable bottles are collected separately in our city.
items.why: recycle + -able → recyclable (e tushadi), sifat.

items.s: We should use water more carefuly in summer.
items.fix: We should use water more carefully in summer.
items.why: careful + -ly = carefully (ikki l).

items.s: The pollute in Tashkent is worse in winter.
items.fix: The pollution in Tashkent is worse in winter.
items.why: Artikl 'the' dan keyin OT kerak: pollute (fe'l) → pollution (ot).

items.s: Water scarcity is a pressing issue in Central Asia.
items.why: scarce + -ity = scarcity (ot); oxirgi e tushadi.

items.s: Solar power is an environmentaly friendly source of energy.
items.fix: Solar power is an environmentally friendly source of energy.
items.why: -al + -ly = -ally: environmentally (ikki l).

items.s: Our class watched an educational documentary about melting glaciers.
items.why: education + -al = educational (sifat).

items.s: Walking in the mountains brings me a lot of happyness.
items.fix: Walking in the mountains brings me a lot of happiness.
items.why: happy + -ness: y → i, happiness.

items.s: Some people think fighting climate change is hopeless, but I disagree.
items.why: hope + -less = hopeless (umidsiz), sifat.

items.s: Fossil fuels are not a sustainability source of energy.
items.fix: Fossil fuels are not a sustainable source of energy.
items.why: Ot (source) oldidan SIFAT kerak: sustainable. sustainability — ot.

items.s: Conservationists want stricter penalties for polluters.
items.why: -ist va -er odam bildiradi: conservationist, polluter.

Ta'rif oldidagi belgiga qarang: (n) — ot, (adj) — sifat, (person) — odam. Suffiks yordam beradi: -tion / -ity / -ness / -ant → ot; -able / -ful / -less / -ive → sifat; -ist → odam.

3.title: Grammar Auction: ought to, be able to, could
3.stage: YANGI MAVZU (ought to / be able to) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
3.goal: OUGHT TO / OUGHT NOT TO, BE ABLE TO ning barcha zamonlari va could / was able to farqi: to'g'ri gapni xato gapdan ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ought'dan keyin 'to' bormi, be able to to'g'ri zamondami, could o'rnida was able to kerakmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: will can → will be able to).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: You ought to upgrade your phone's software regularly.
items.why: ought + TO + V1: ought to upgrade.

items.s: Parents ought limit their children's screen time.

items.why: ought dan keyin doim TO keladi.

items.s: Next year I will can build my own app.

items.why: can'ning kelajak shakli yo'q → will be able to.

items.s: My grandmother wasn't able to use a smartphone until last year.

items.why: O'tgan zamondagi umumiy qobiliyat → could.

items.s: Since we got fast internet, we have been able to study online.
items.why: Present Perfect'da can yo'q → have been able to.

items.s: The server crashed yesterday, but the engineers could fix it in an hour.
items.fix: The server crashed yesterday, but the engineers were able to fix it in an hour.
items.why: Bitta aniq holatda uddalash → was/were able to, could emas.

items.s: Schools ought not to ignore cyberbullying.
items.why: Inkor: ought NOT to + V1.

items.s: He oughts to protect his privacy online.
items.fix: He ought to protect his privacy online.
items.why: Modal fe'l -s olmaydi: he ought to.

items.s: Are you able to work without your laptop?
items.why: Savol: Be + S + able to + V1?

items.s: They didn't able to connect to the Wi-Fi.
items.fix: They weren't able to connect to the Wi-Fi.
items.why: able — sifat: inkor was/were not bilan yasaladi, did bilan emas.

items.s: One day, robots will be able to do most repetitive jobs.

3.title: Board Game: Tech advice and abilities
3.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 4-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
3.goal: Ought to bilan maslahat berish, be able to ni turli zamonlarda (will be / was / have been able to) aytish, could va was able to ni tanlash; texnologiya haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi — javobni TO'LIQ gap bilan aytadi (ko'pincha ought to / be able to bilan).
Guruh tekshiradi: ought'dan keyin 'to' bormi, zamon to'g'rimi (will be able to, have been able to, was able to)? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk' kataklarida kamida 2 ta gap va kamida bitta modal bo'lishi shart.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

3.title: Dominoes: modal questions and short answers
3.stage: Sinf mashqlari ichida, 'could yoki was able to' mashqidan keyin — modal savol va qisqa javoblarni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
3.goal: Be able to (am / was / will be / have been able to), ought to va modal takrori (can, could, must, have to, may, should) savollariga mos qisqa javobni topish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga mos javobni boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping.
Qisqa javob savoldagi modal va egaga mos bo'lishi shart: Were you able…? → Yes, I was; Ought I to…? → Yes, you ought to; Could she…? → No, she couldn't.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni juftlikda savol-javob qilib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.

Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300').

4.title: Grammar Auction: other ways to talk about the future
4.stage: YANGI MAVZU (kelajakning 8 ta shakli) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
4.goal: Kelajak shakllari (Present Simple — jadval, Present Continuous — reja, be about to, be due to, be to, be bound to, be likely/unlikely to) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: kelajak shakli vaziyatga mosmi, about / due / likely / bound dan keyin 'to' tushib qolmaganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: is about leaving → is about to leave).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

4.title: Board Game: My future career
4.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 5-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
4.goal: Vaziyatga qarab kelajak shaklini tanlash (jadval, kelishilgan reja, dalilli bashorat, juda yaqin kelajak, rasmiy reja, ishonch, ehtimol) va ish-karyera haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: kerakli kelajak shakli bilan TO'LIQ gap aytadi.
Guruh tekshiradi: jadval → Present Simple, kelishilgan reja → am/is/are + V-ing, about / due / likely / bound dan keyin 'to' bormi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk' kataklarida kamida 2 xil kelajak shakli bo'lishi shart.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.a: e.g. AI is likely to replace some office jobs, but teachers are unlikely to lose theirs.

squares.a: e.g. I'm going to work flexible hours. I'm likely to earn well. I'm bound to get promoted.

4.title: Dominoes: future plans — questions and answers
4.stage: Sinf mashqlari ichida, 'Kelajak shaklini tanlang' mashqidan keyin — savol-javobni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
4.goal: Kelajak shakllari (going to, Present Continuous, Present Simple, about to, due to, be to, likely / bound to) bilan berilgan savollarga mos javobni topish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga mos javobni boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping.
Javob savolga shakl va ma'no jihatdan mos bo'lishi shart: Are you going to…? → Yes, I am; Does it open…? → No, it doesn't; How long…? → Three months.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni juftlikda savol-javob qilib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.

Three months. It's due to end in August.

Definitely. Take an umbrella to work.

She is to open a new IT park next week.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Tushuntirishda kelajak shakli ishlatsa (masalan: 'If you work hard, you are bound to get it…') — yana +1 bonus.

Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.title: Find someone who… is going to study abroad
4.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
4.goal: Are you going to…? / Are you …ing…? / Are you likely to…? / Are you about to…? savollarini tuzish va reja hamda karyera haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Are you going to study abroad after school?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? / Where? / Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 gap bilan aytib beradi: 'Kamola is going to…', 'Aziz is meeting…'.
Ustoz kalitdagi savollar bilan tekshiradi: kelishilgan reja — V-ing, going / likely / about dan keyin 'to'.

5.title: Grammar Auction: despite, because of, in order to
5.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (9 xil ravish iborasi) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
5.goal: Ravish iboralarini to'g'ri qurish: despite / in spite of + ot yoki V-ing, because of / due to + ot, in order to + V1, tarz → joy → vaqt tartibi; xato gapni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga eslatma yozing: despite / because of / due to + OT; in order to + V1; tarz → joy → vaqt.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: iboradan keyin to'g'ri shakl kelganmi (ot, V-ing yoki V1) va so'z tartibi to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'Despite he was injured' → 'Despite being injured').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Despite his chronic illness, my grandfather walks every morning.
items.why: despite + ot (his chronic illness) — to'g'ri; despite dan keyin to'liq gap kelmaydi.

items.s: Despite she had a cold, she went to the gym.
items.fix: Despite having a cold, she went to the gym.
items.why: despite dan keyin to'liq gap kelmaydi: despite + V-ing/ot (yoki although + gap).

items.s: Many people put on weight because of a sedentary lifestyle.
items.why: because of + ot (a sedentary lifestyle) — sabab iborasi.

items.s: Because of he eats too much junk food, he often feels tired.
items.fix: Because he eats too much junk food, he often feels tired.
items.why: To'liq gap (he eats…) oldidan because; because of faqat ot bilan keladi.

items.s: He goes to the gym every day for build stamina.
items.fix: He goes to the gym every day in order to build stamina.
items.why: Maqsad + fe'l → in order to / to + V1; 'for' dan keyin faqat ot keladi.

items.s: My sister does yoga in order to improve her flexibility.
items.why: Maqsad: in order to + V1 (improve).

items.s: The doctor examined the patient with great care.
items.why: Tarz iborasi: with great care — gap oxirida.

items.s: Aziza swam yesterday in the pool slowly.
items.fix: Aziza swam slowly in the pool yesterday.
items.why: Tartib: tarz (slowly) → joy (in the pool) → vaqt (yesterday).

items.s: A balanced diet affects our well-being to a great extent.
items.why: Daraja iborasi: to a great extent = katta darajada.

items.s: In spite the pain, the runner finished the race.
items.fix: In spite of the pain, the runner finished the race.
items.why: in spite OF + ot; 'of' tushib qolmaydi (despite esa 'of'siz).

items.s: In case of an allergic reaction, call a doctor immediately.
items.why: Shart: in case of + ot; gap boshida vergul bilan.

items.s: Her recovery was slow due the infection.
items.fix: Her recovery was slow due to the infection.
items.why: due TO + ot = … sababli; 'to' tushib qolmaydi.

5.title: Board Game: when, where, why and how?

5.title: Dominoes: questions and adverbial answers
5.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichi o'rnida: savol so'zi ↔ ibora turi (12 daqiqa)
5.goal: Savolga (Why? When? Where? How? How often? How much?) mos turdagi ravish iborasi bilan javob topish: sabab, maqsad, vaqt, joy, tarz, takrorlik, daraja, shart, yon berish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savolga qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi javob mos kelishini toping.
Maslahat: 'Why…?' ga sabab (because of / due to / thanks to) yoki maqsad (in order to) iborasi, 'How often…?' ga takrorlik iborasi javob bo'ladi — ma'noni ham tekshiring.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni savol-javob qilib ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har javobdagi ibora turini aytadi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

In the long run.

Thanks to vaccines and better food.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Ravish iboralari yordam beradi: 'You get it because of…', 'People do it in order to…', 'It often happens in old age'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va tarjima qilish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

5.goal: Ravish iborasi bor savollarni tuzish va berish (Do you … once in a while? Are you … in order to …? Have you ever … despite …?); sog'lom odatlar haqida gapirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi; ravish iborasi savolda saqlanadi (masalan: Do you eat junk food only once in a while?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? / Where? / How often?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani ravish iborasi bilan aytib beradi (masalan: Aziz goes for a walk after dinner every evening).

6.title: Grammar Auction: allowed to, permitted to, supposed to
6.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (allowed / permitted / supposed) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
6.goal: be allowed / permitted / supposed + to + V1 shaklini to'g'ri qurish: 'be' yordamchisi, 'to', V1, zamon (was allowed to, will be allowed to); ega ot bo'lsa 'to' yo'q; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskada formula tursin: S + am/is/are/was/were + allowed/permitted/supposed + to + V1.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: 'be' bormi, 'to' bormi, fe'l V1 shaklidami, zamon to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'He is allowed stay late' → 'He is allowed to stay late').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: At our school, students are allowed to use dictionaries in class.
items.why: be + allowed to + V1 (use): ruxsat berilgan.

items.s: We are not allowed use our phones during lessons.
items.fix: We are not allowed to use our phones during lessons.
items.why: allowed dan keyin 'to' shart: allowed TO + V1.

items.s: Every citizen is supposed to obey the law.
items.why: Qoida bo'yicha kutilgan: be supposed to + V1 (obey).

items.s: Drivers are supposed wearing seat belts.
items.fix: Drivers are supposed to wear seat belts.
items.why: supposed TO + V1 (wear), -ing shakl emas.

items.s: Last year I can stay up late on Saturdays.
items.fix: Last year I was allowed to stay up late on Saturdays.
items.why: O'tgan zamondagi ruxsat → was allowed to (yoki could); 'can' — hozirgi zamon.

items.s: Citizens aged 18 and over are permitted to vote in elections.
items.why: Rasmiy ruxsat (qonun): be permitted to + V1.

items.s: Smoking is not permitted in the hospital.
items.why: Ega — ot (smoking), shuning uchun oxirida 'to' yo'q: rasmiy taqiq.

items.s: You suppose to switch off your phone in the cinema.
items.fix: You are supposed to switch off your phone in the cinema.
items.why: 'be' yordamchisi shart: You ARE supposed to…

items.s: Eating is not allowed to in the library.
items.fix: Eating is not allowed in the library.
items.why: Ega ot/V-ing bo'lsa (eating), 'allowed' dan keyin 'to' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: Next year my brother will be allowed to drive.
items.why: can'ning kelasi zamoni yo'q → will be allowed to + V1.

items.s: Are we allow to leave early today?
items.fix: Are we allowed to leave early today?
items.why: be + allowED (3-shakl): Are we allowed to…?

items.s: I was supposed to call my grandmother yesterday, but I forgot.
items.why: was supposed to = qilishim kerak edi, lekin qilinmadi.

6.title: Dominoes: signs and what they mean
6.stage: Kirish savolidan keyin yoki 'Kombinatsiya' o'rnida: belgilar va qoidalar (12 daqiqa)
6.goal: Belgi va e'lonlar (NO SMOKING, STAFF ONLY…) ma'nosini be allowed / permitted / supposed to bilan aytilgan gapga ulash; rasmiy va og'zaki shaklni farqlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi belgi (masalan: KEEP OFF THE GRASS) ma'nosini beradigan gap qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'KEEP OFF THE GRASS means you aren't supposed to walk on the lawn.' Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.
Bonus (+1): har guruh maktabimiz uchun bitta yangi belgi o'ylab topadi va ma'nosini allowed / permitted / supposed bilan aytadi.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yangi grammatika yordam beradi: 'People aren't allowed to…', 'You are supposed to… in this place', 'It says what citizens are permitted to do' (agar bu so'z kartada taqiqlanmagan bo'lsa).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va tarjima qilish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: Find someone who… is allowed to stay up late

6.goal: be allowed / supposed / permitted to bilan savol tuzish (Are you allowed to…? Were you allowed to…? Are you supposed to…?) va uydagi, maktabdagi qoidalar haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi; savol 'be' bilan boshlanadi (masalan: Were you allowed to stay up late last weekend?).
Qatorga mos javob bergan (masalan, 'wasn't allowed' qatorida 'No' degan) odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? / Who decided?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani aytib beradi (masalan: Lola isn't allowed to use her phone at the dinner table).

6.title: Speaking cards: rules, rights and laws
6.stage: Listening'dan keyin, IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubida juftlikda gapirish (12 daqiqa)
6.goal: Qoidalar va qonunlar mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; har javobda be allowed / permitted / supposed to (turli zamonlarda) va qonun lug'atini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi (imtihonchi) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 marta allowed / permitted / supposed to ishlatadi.
Imtihonchi sanaydi: har to'g'ri shakl +1 ball, o'tgan yoki kelasi zamonda ishlatilsa (was allowed to, will be allowed to) +1 bonus.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What are you allowed to do now that you weren't allowed to do as a child?
Are you allowed to use your phone in class? Do you think this rule is fair?

6.title: Sentence Race: allowed, permitted, supposed
6.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa)
6.goal: be + allowed / permitted / supposed + to + V1 gapida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: darak, inkor, savol va turli zamonlar.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Eslatma: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi bor so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert; gapni o'zbekchaga to'g'ri tarjima qilsa +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: Quiz Board: rules, rights and the law
6.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida, Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
6.goal: be allowed / permitted / supposed to shakllari, xatoni tuzatish va qonun lug'atini (election, penalty, curfew, jury…) o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Law words 400').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

7.title: Grammar Auction: the or no article?
7.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Aniq artikl 'the' to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish: daryo, dengiz, cho'l, ko'l, cho'qqi va davlat nomlari, superlativ, ikkinchi marta tilga olish, umumiy ma'no; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gapda ortiqcha 'the', tushib qolgan 'the' yoki 'the' o'rniga 'a' bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va qoidani aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'The France' → 'France' — davlat nomi the'siz).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The Uzbekistan is a country in Central Asia.
items.fix: Uzbekistan is a country in Central Asia.
items.why: Davlat nomi (United/Republic/Kingdom yoki ko'plik shakl bo'lmasa) — the'siz.

items.s: The Amu Darya and the Syr Darya flow towards the Aral Sea.
items.why: Daryo va dengiz nomlari — the bilan.

items.s: The Mount Everest is in the Himalayas.
items.fix: Mount Everest is in the Himalayas.
items.why: Cho'qqi (Mount …) — the'siz; tog' tizmasi (the Himalayas) — the bilan.

items.s: Many young people move from the countryside to cities for work.
items.why: the countryside — doim the; umumiy ko'plik (cities) — the'siz.

items.s: Congestion is a serious problem in most big cities.
items.why: Umumiy ma'nodagi sanalmas ot (congestion) — the'siz.

items.s: Kyzylkum is one of the largest deserts in Central Asia.
items.fix: The Kyzylkum is one of the largest deserts in Central Asia.
items.why: Cho'l nomlari — the bilan: the Kyzylkum, the Sahara.

items.s: My cousin lives in the Netherlands, near Amsterdam.
items.why: Ko'plik shakldagi davlat — the Netherlands; shahar — the'siz.

items.s: Tashkent has highest population density in the country.

items.why: Superlativ oldida doim the: the highest.

items.s: Lake Baikal in Russia is the deepest lake in the world.
items.why: Ko'l (Lake …) — the'siz; superlativ va 'the world' — the bilan.

items.s: I visited a landmark in Bukhara. A landmark was over 1,000 years old.
items.fix: I visited a landmark in Bukhara. The landmark was over 1,000 years old.
items.why: Birinchi marta — a, ikkinchi marta (ma'lum bo'lgach) — the.

items.s: The UAE and the USA are famous for their high-rise buildings.
items.why: Nomida United/States bor davlatlar — the bilan.

items.s: Sun sets later in summer than in winter.

7.title: Board Game: the Nile, Lake Baikal, the biggest city
7.stage: Sinf mashqlari o'rniga yoki ulardan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Geografik nomlar, superlativ, 'go to school' va umumiy ma'noda 'the' yoki artiklsiz variantni og'zaki tanlash; shahar va urbanizatsiya so'zlari bilan qisqa gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'the' kerakmi yoki yo'qmi aytadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap bilan gapiradi.
Bitta o'quvchi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar kalitini ushlab turadi. Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida 3 ta to'g'ri artikl ishlatilishi kerak; guruh sanaydi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

7.title: Dominoes: the longest, the deepest, the highest
7.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — superlativ va geografik nomlarni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Superlativ (the longest, the deepest, the biggest) va geografik nomlar oldida 'the' / artiklsiz (the Nile, Mount Everest, Lake Baikal, the UK) ishlatishni ta'rif ↔ nom juftligi orqali mustahkamlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ta'rif (masalan: 'The deepest lake in the world is') qaysi joy nomiga ulanadi — toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har bir nomda 'the' bor-yo'qligini qoidasi bilan aytadi (daryo — the, ko'l — the'siz, cho'qqi — the'siz).
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

8.title: Grammar Auction: had better, would rather, prefer
8.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: had better + V1, would rather + V1 (+ than + V1), would rather + boshqa ega + Past Simple, prefer … to …, prefer to … rather than … qoliplari to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish va tuzatish (media, musiqa mavzusida).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: qolipdan keyin fe'l shakli to'g'rimi (V1 / V-ing / Past Simple), 'to' yoki 'than' o'z joyidami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'had better to go' → 'had better go', 'prefer tea than coffee' → 'prefer tea to coffee').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

8.title: Board Game: You'd better… I'd rather… I prefer…
8.stage: Sinf mashqlari o'rniga yoki ulardan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: Tavsiya/ogohlantirish (had better), hozirgi tanlov (would rather … than, would rather + you + Past Simple) va umumiy afzallik (prefer … to …) qoliplarini media, musiqa va ko'ngilochar mavzuda og'zaki ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'sh joyni to'ldiradi, xatoni tuzatadi, qayta yozadi yoki to'liq gap bilan gapiradi.
Bitta o'quvchi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar kalitini ushlab turadi. Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for …' kataklarida kamida 2 xil qolip (had better / would rather / prefer) ishlatilishi kerak.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

8.title: Dominoes: we'd better… / I'd rather… / I prefer…
8.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — formula → gap qolipini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: Gap boshini to'g'ri davom bilan ulash: had better (not) + V1, would rather (not) + V1 … than …, would rather + you + Past Simple, prefer … to …, prefer to … rather than …, would prefer to …
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomoniga ulanadi — toping.
Ulashda ikki narsaga qarang: grammatika (V1 / to + V-ing / than / rather than / Past Simple) va ma'no (gap mantiqan to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

keep their children away from cameras.

publish rumours as facts.
Paparazzi would rather sell one secret photo
than sell a hundred normal ones.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda had better / would rather / prefer bilan to'g'ri gap aytilsa (masalan: 'Stars would rather these people left them alone'), jamoa +1 qo'shimcha ball oladi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (masalan: Aziz prefers podcasts to radio).

9.title: Grammar Auction: see him cross / see him crossing
9.stage: YANGI MAVZU (see / hear + O + V1 / V-ing) tushuntirilgach, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: See / hear / watch / notice / feel + ob'ekt + V1 (to'liq harakat) yoki V-ing (jarayon) to'g'ri ishlatilganini ajratish; passiv (was seen to leave / leaving) hamda 'to', V2 va -s xatolarini tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: sezgi fe'li + ob'ektdan keyin V1 yoki V-ing to'g'ri keldimi, passivda 'to' bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin qoidani aytishi shart: 'aktivda to yo'q', 'ob'ektdan keyin V1 yoki V-ing, V2 emas', 'passivda to + V1'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.why: Aktivda 'to' ishlatilmaydi: see + ob'ekt + V1.

items.why: Ob'ektdan keyin V2 emas: V1 (celebrate) yoki V-ing (celebrating).

items.s: I noticed the referee stop the fight in the third round.
items.why: Hakam jangni to'xtatdi — to'liq harakat → notice + O + V1.

items.fix: I heard her sing the national anthem before the final.
items.why: Ob'ektdan keyin V1 — -s qo'shilmaydi: heard her sing (yoki singing).

9.title: Board Game: I saw him score!
9.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki ularning bir qismi o'rniga (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: Sezgi fe'llari + ob'ekt + V1 / V-ing bilan og'zaki gap tuzish, gapni passivga aylantirish (was seen to … / was heard …ing), xatoni tuzatish; sport lug'ati (referee, underdog, sportsmanship, comeback) bilan gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi (see / hear / watch / notice / feel + ob'ekt + V1 yoki V-ing).
'Correct' kataklarida xatoni topib, to'g'ri gapni aytadi; 'Make it passive' kataklarida was seen / was heard + to V1 yoki V-ing ishlatadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (javoblar ustoz varag'ida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for … seconds' kataklarida vaqtni telefon bilan o'lchang: kamida 2 marta sezgi fe'li + ob'ekt + V1 / V-ing ishlatilishi shart.

9.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: sezgi fe'li + ob'ekt + V1 / V-ing qolipini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: Sezgi fe'li + ob'ekt bilan boshlangan gapni mantiqan va grammatik to'g'ri davom (V1 / V-ing / passivda to V1) bilan ulash; sport kollokatsiyalari (land a punch, save a penalty, a unanimous decision).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (kim + sezgi fe'li + ob'ekt) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davomga (V1 / V-ing / to V1) ulanadi — toping.
Ulashda ikkalasini tekshiring: ma'no (kim nima qiladi? qo'ng'iroq chalinadi, hakam qo'l ko'taradi, chempion gapiradi) va grammatika (aktivda 'to' yo'q; 'was seen / was heard' dan keyin to V1).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.

Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi: 'Aziz has seen …'.

Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: ega → sezgi fe'li → ob'ekt → V1 / V-ing (passivda: was seen / was heard → to V1 yoki V-ing) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Tinish belgilari so'zga yopishgan: katta harf — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi — gap oxiri.

10.title: Grammar Auction: one, the one, ones, the other
10.stage: YANGI MAVZU (one / the one / ones / other) tushuntirilgach, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
10.goal: ONE (noaniq) / THE ONE (aniq) / ONES, THE ONES (ko'plik), sifat + one, ANOTHER / THE OTHER / OTHERS to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: one / the one / ones / another / the other / others to'g'ri tanlanganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin qoidani aytishi shart: 'noma'lum → one', 'aniq → the one', 'ko'plik → ones', 'ikkitadan ikkinchisi → the other'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.

10.goal: one / ones / the one / another / the other / others ishlatib xarid va moda haqida savol tuzish va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.

10.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki keyingi darsda Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 bo'lim × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Shopping words 300').

11.title: Grammar Auction: It was … who, What … is, did + V1, Never had…
11.stage: Yangi mavzu (Emphasis) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: It-cleft (It was … who/that), What-clause (What … is/was), emphatic do/did + V1 va inkor fronting + inversiya (Never had…, Rarely do…) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: urg'u shakli (It was … who/that, What … is, did + V1, Never had …) to'g'ri tuzilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'who he built' → 'who built', 'did worked' → 'did work', 'Never a scientist had' → 'Never had a scientist').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

items.s: It was Alexander Fleming who discovered penicillin in 1928.
items.why: It-cleft: shaxsga urg'u → It was + shaxs + who + qolgan gap.

items.s: It was Ulugh Beg who he built the observatory in Samarkand.
items.fix: It was Ulugh Beg who built the observatory in Samarkand.
items.why: Cleft'da ega takrorlanmaydi: who dan keyin 'he' kerak emas.

items.s: What surprised the researchers was the speed of the reaction.
items.why: What-clause: What + fe'l + was + urg'u (the speed).

items.s: What the team needs are a bigger laboratory.
items.fix: What the team needs is a bigger laboratory.
items.why: What-clause + is (birlik): a bigger laboratory — birlik.

items.s: I do understand the theory, but I can't explain it yet.
items.why: Emphatic do: do + V1 (understand) — 'rostdan tushunaman'.

items.s: The experiment did worked in the end.
items.fix: The experiment did work in the end.
items.why: did + V1: did work (worked emas).

items.s: Never a scientist had seen such a result before.
items.fix: Never had a scientist seen such a result before.
items.why: Never gap boshida → inversiya: had + ega + V3.

items.s: Not only did Ibn Sina write about medicine, but he also studied astronomy.
items.why: Not only gap boshida → did + ega + V1 (did Ibn Sina write).

items.s: It was in 1905 when Einstein published his special theory of relativity.
items.fix: It was in 1905 that Einstein published his special theory of relativity.
items.why: It-cleft'da vaqtga urg'u → that (when emas).

items.s: In a leaking shed in Paris, the Curies made their greatest discovery.
items.why: Fronting: joy holati gap boshida; inkor so'z yo'q — inversiya shart emas.

items.s: Rarely scientists refuse a patent for such an important invention.
items.fix: Rarely do scientists refuse a patent for such an important invention.
items.why: Rarely gap boshida → do + ega + V1 (inversiya).

items.s: It is careful analysis that turns data into knowledge.
items.why: It-cleft (narsa): It is + urg'u + that + fe'l.

11.title: Board Game: It WAS science that changed the world!
11.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: Oddiy gapni urg'uli gapga aylantirish (It was … who/that, What … is/was, do/does/did + V1, Never/Rarely/Not only + inversiya) va fan mavzusida og'zaki gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni urg'u bilan qayta aytadi (It was … who/that, What … is, did + V1, Never have I …) yoki xatoni tuzatadi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida bitta urg'uli gap ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga yurish, orqaga qaytish, yana zar tashlash yoki navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

11.title: Dominoes: emphatic sentence halves
11.stage: Grammatika jadvali tugagach, Science CORE 20 lug'atidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — keyingi darsda takror uchun.
11.goal: Urg'uli gap boshini (It was …, What …, do/does + V1, Never had …, Not only did …, fronting) grammatik va mantiqan to'g'ri davomi bilan ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomoniga ulanadi — toping (who/that, is/was, 'he' → does + V1, 'I' → do + V1, inversiyaga qarang).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib, urg'uli so'zni kuchli aytib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

11.goal: Cleft savollar (Was it … who…? Is it … that…?), 'Is X what you…?' savollari va urg'uli javoblar (Yes, I do…! / No, never have I…) bilan gaplashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi — iloji bo'lsa urg'uli shaklda (Was it your mother who…? Is space what…?).
Javob beruvchi ham urg'u bilan javob beradi: 'Yes, it was my mother who…', 'Yes, I do check…!', 'No — never have I…'.
Qatorga mos javob bergan odamning ismini yozadi ('never' qatorida — 'No, never have I…' degan odam) va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? When? Who?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni urg'uli gaplar bilan aytib beradi (It was Aziz who…).

11.title: Sentence Race: emphatic sentences
11.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash bosqichida tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — uyga vazifadan oldin 5 daqiqalik takror.
11.goal: Cleft, What-clause, emphatic did va inversiyali gaplarda (Never had…, Rarely do…, Not only did…) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: bosh harfli so'z — boshida, nuqtali so'z — oxirida, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxirida.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib, urg'uli qismni kuchli aytib o'qiydi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim (Emphasis forms, Correct it, Science words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar. Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).

12.title: Grammar Auction: The more…, the more… / the poor are
12.stage: Yangi mavzu (The more…, the more… va the + sifat) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: The + comparative, the + comparative qolipi (ikkala qismda 'the', ikki comparative birga emas, umumiy haqiqatda will emas), qisqa shakl (the sooner, the better) va the + sifat + ko'plik fe'lni tekshirish; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ikkala qismda 'the' bormi, comparative to'g'rimi, the + sifatdan keyin fe'l ko'plikmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: '…, more tax' → '…, the more tax', 'The poor is' → 'The poor are', 'more cheaper' → 'cheaper').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

items.s: The more you save, the richer you become.
items.why: Ikkala qismda the + comparative: the more …, the richer …

items.s: The more you earn, more tax you pay.

items.why: Ikkinchi qismda ham 'the' kerak: the more tax.

items.s: The poor is often the first to suffer.

items.why: the + sifat = odamlar guruhi → ko'plik fe'l: are.

items.s: The elderly need a strong safety net.
items.why: the elderly = keksalar (guruh) → need (ko'plik, -s yo'q).

items.s: The more cheaper the bread, the happier the poor.
items.fix: The cheaper the bread, the happier the poor.
items.why: Ikki comparative birga emas: cheaper (more cheaper emas).

items.s: The higher the interest rate, the deeper people sink into debt.
items.why: the higher + ot (fe'lsiz ham bo'ladi), the deeper + ega + fe'l.

items.s: We must act now: the sooner is better.
items.fix: We must act now: the sooner, the better.
items.why: Qisqa shakl: the sooner, the better (is emas).

items.s: The unemployed are finding it harder to pay their rent.
items.why: the unemployed = ishsizlar → are, their (ko'plik).

items.fix: The more you practise, the better you speak.
items.why: Umumiy haqiqat → Present Simple (will emas).

12.title: Board Game: The more you say, the further you go!
12.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Ikki gapni 'The …, the …' bilan birlashtirish, the + sifat guruh nomlarini (the poor, the elderly, the unemployed) aytish, xatoni tuzatish va qashshoqlik mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni 'The …, the …' bilan tugatadi yoki birlashtiradi, guruh nomini aytadi yoki xatoni tuzatadi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi (ikkala qismda 'the' bormi?); shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida bitta 'the …, the …' gap ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga yurish, orqaga qaytish, yana zar tashlash yoki navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

12.title: Dominoes: the …, the … halves and the + adjective
12.stage: Grammatika jadvali tugagach, Poverty CORE 20 lug'atidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — keyingi darsda takror uchun.
12.goal: 'The …, the …' gap yarimlarini mantiqan to'g'ri ulash, qisqa shakllarni (the sooner, the better; the more, the merrier) savolga moslash va the + sifat guruh nomlarini ma'nosi bilan ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi yarim gap qaysi toshning chap tomoniga ulanadi — toping (ma'no mantiqiymi: nima oshsa, nima o'zgaradi?).

Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus +1: tushuntirishda 'the …, the …' gap ishlatilsa (masalan: 'The more you have of it, the richer you are').
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you think the more you read, the more you learn?).

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (Aziz thinks the rich should pay more tax).

rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bog'lovchi (even, even though, even if, in case, as long as, provided) to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?

rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

14.title: Grammar Auction: it, so do I, one, this, hers
14.stage: Referencing tushuntirilib, Kombinatsiyadan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: Referencing: anaphoric (he / it / they), substitution (so do I, neither, one, I hope not), ellipsis (I don't), comparative (hers) va demonstratives (this) to'g'ri ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ishora so'zi (he, it, they, so do I, one, this, hers, the latter) to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'So I do' → 'So do I').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: My sister speaks three languages, and so do I.
items.why: Substitution: so + yordamchi (do) + ega = men ham (speak three languages).

items.s: A: I love Uzbek poetry. B: So I do.
items.fix: A: I love Uzbek poetry. B: So do I.
items.why: Tartib: So + yordamchi + ega → So do I.

items.s: A: I don't enjoy long novels. B: Neither do I.
items.why: Inkor gapga qo'shilish: Neither + do + I.

items.s: I need a dictionary — a bilingual.
items.fix: I need a dictionary — a bilingual one.
items.why: Sifatdan keyin birlik otni 'one' almashtiradi: a bilingual one.

items.s: Aziz likes reading poetry, but I don't like.
items.fix: Aziz likes reading poetry, but I don't.
items.why: Ellipsis: fe'l ham, to'ldiruvchi ham tushadi — I don't.

items.s: Zamakhshari wrote a famous dictionary. It is still studied by scholars today.
items.why: Anaphoric: It = the dictionary (narsa → it).

items.s: Alisher Navoi was a great poet. It wrote in Chagatai and Persian.
items.fix: Alisher Navoi was a great poet. He wrote in Chagatai and Persian.
items.why: Shaxs → he; 'it' faqat narsa uchun.

items.s: Many languages are disappearing. This worries linguists around the world.
items.why: Yozma matnda oldingi gapdagi fikrga 'this' ishora qiladi.

items.s: My pronunciation is worse than her.
items.fix: My pronunciation is worse than hers.
items.why: Comparative reference: hers = her pronunciation (egalik olmoshi).

items.s: A: Will the exam be difficult? B: I hope not.
items.why: Substitution: I hope not = I hope it won't be difficult.

items.s: I bought two new dictionaries. It is very useful.
items.fix: I bought two new dictionaries. They are very useful.
items.why: Ko'plik ot (dictionaries) → they are.

items.s: Zamakhshari knew Persian and Arabic, but he wrote mostly in the latter.
items.why: the latter = oxirgi aytilgani (Arabic); the former = birinchisi (Persian).

14.title: Board Game: What does it refer to?
14.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Takrorni olib tashlang' mashqidan keyin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: Ishora so'zlari (it, this, one/ones, hers, the former/the latter), So do I / Neither can I, qisqa javoblar (ellipsis) va til mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Zar tashlagan o'yinchi topshiriqni bajaradi: ishora so'zi nimani bildirishini aytadi, qo'shilish gapini aytadi (So do I, Neither can I) yoki xatoni tuzatadi.
Guruh tekshiradi: yordamchi fe'l mos kelmasa (masalan: 'I can't…' → 'Neither do I') yoki takror ot qolsa — javob xato, o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida 3 ta ishora so'zi (it, this, they, one, so…) ishlatilishi shart; guruh sanaydi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish). Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

14.title: Dominoes: So do I, Neither did I, one, this
14.stage: Sinf mashqlarida, 'Ishora nimaga?' mashqi o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: Gapni to'g'ri javob yoki davom bilan ulash: So / Neither + yordamchi fe'l, ellipsis (her brother can't), one/ones, the latter, hers, this, cataphoric he va exophoric that.

15.title: Grammar Auction: feel bad, look tired, sound like
15.stage: YANGI MAVZU (14 ta bog'lovchi fe'l) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
15.goal: Bog'lovchi fe'ldan (feel, look, sound, taste, become, get, grow, remain, stay…) keyin SIFAT kelishini, 'sound + sifat' va 'sound like + ot', 'look at + ravish' farqini ajratish, xato gapni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi (faqat o'qib berish yetmaydi: 'to' / 'too' farqi ko'rinishi kerak). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bog'lovchi fe'ldan keyin sifat turibdimi yoki xato bormi (-ly ravish, ortiqcha 'to' yoki 'like')?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi — qoidani ham aytishi shart (masalan: 'taste — bog'lovchi fe'l, keyin sifat: delicious').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

15.goal: Bog'lovchi fe'l + sifat bilan og'zaki gap tuzish, sifat/ravishni tanlash, uch guruhni (holat, sezgi, o'zgarish) ajratish va psixologiya so'zlari (anxious, stressed, burnout) bilan gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: sifat yoki ravishni tanlaydi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki TO'LIQ gap aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: bog'lovchi fe'ldan keyin sifat turibdimi? 'look at', 'smell the flowers' kabi harakatda ravish bo'lishi mumkin. Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.

15.title: Dominoes: linking verb sentence halves
