15.goal: Bog'lovchi fe'lli gaplarda (tastes delicious, looked tired, sounds like, turned pale, feel like going) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball; gapdagi bog'lovchi fe'lni va uning guruhini (holat / sezgi / o'zgarish) aytsa yana +1 ball.
Keyin jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Grandma's soup always tastes delicious.
She looked tired after the long exam.
That sounds like a good idea to me.
He remained calm during the whole interview.
It is getting dark, so let's go home.
Many students get stressed before their final exams.
Her face turned pale when she heard the news.
He grew more confident with every performance.
I don't feel like going out tonight.
Why do you look so worried today?

15.title: Quiz Board: linking verbs and emotions
15.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
15.goal: Sifat/ravish tanlovi, xatoni tuzatish, psixologiya lug'ati va 'Say it!' bo'limida bog'lovchi fe'l bilan og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim), har birida 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida to'liq gap aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: The soup tastes (delicious / deliciously).
You look (happy / happily) today.
He looked (careful / carefully) at the map.
I feel (bad / badly) about it.
He smelled the milk (careful / carefully) before drinking it.
She looks sadly.
He became to angry.
Your idea sounds like interesting.
qs.a: Your idea sounds interesting. / …sounds like an interesting idea.

qs.q: The flowers smell sweetly.
He seems be ill.
qs.a: He seems to be ill. / He seems ill.

qs.q: The feeling of being alone and sad is …
Not being able to sleep at night is …
Extreme tiredness from too much work or stress is …
The ability to understand other people's feelings is …
The ability to recover quickly after difficult times is …
Use 'feel' + adjective: how do you feel right now?
qs.a: e.g. I feel relaxed. / I feel a bit tired.

qs.q: Your friend has a new haircut. Pay him a compliment with 'look'.
Name the four 'change' verbs and use one in a sentence.
qs.a: become, get, grow, turn — e.g. It's getting cold.

qs.q: Describe your favourite food with 'smell' and 'taste'.
qs.a: e.g. Plov smells wonderful and tastes delicious.

qs.q: Give a stressed friend advice with 'stay' and 'feel'.
qs.a: e.g. Stay calm — you'll feel better after a short walk.

16.title: Grammar Auction: said, told, would, had done
16.stage: YANGI MAVZU (backshift jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
16.goal: Reported speech (darak gap) to'g'ri yoki xato ekanini ajratish: zamon siljishi (will → would, may → might, has → had), vaqt so'zlari (yesterday → the day before) va say / tell farqi; xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zamon bir qadam orqaga siljiganmi, vaqt so'zi o'zgarganmi, say / tell to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi — qoidani ham aytishi shart (masalan: 'may → might' yoki 'tell + kimga').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: My grandmother said she had raised six children alone.
items.why: Past Simple (raised) → Past Perfect: had raised.

items.s: He said me that he was the eldest of four siblings.
items.fix: He told me that he was the eldest of four siblings.
items.why: say dan keyin kimga (me) kelmaydi: told me yoki said that.

items.s: Aziz said his family would move to Tashkent the following year.
items.why: will → would; next year → the following year.

items.s: When I was ten, my dad said he will teach me to play chess.
items.fix: When I was ten, my dad said he would teach me to play chess.
items.why: will → would: gap o'tmishda aytilgan (o'n yoshimda).

items.s: My father told me that hard work was the key to success.
items.why: tell + kimga (me); is → was.

items.s: Two years ago my sister said she has just finished school.
items.fix: Two years ago my sister said she had just finished school.
items.why: Present Perfect → Past Perfect: has finished → had finished (ikki yil oldin aytilgan).

items.s: Grandpa said his ancestors had come from Bukhara.
items.why: Past Simple (came) → Past Perfect: had come.

items.s: A week ago Dilnoza said her baby brother had been born yesterday.
items.fix: A week ago Dilnoza said her baby brother had been born the day before.
items.why: yesterday → the day before (gap o'tmishda aytilgan).

items.s: They told that the old house belonged to their grandfather.
items.fix: They told us that the old house belonged to their grandfather.
items.why: tell dan keyin kimga kerak: told us (yoki said that).

items.s: My little sister said she could ride a bike without help.
items.why: can → could.

items.s: At Navruz last year, my uncle said he may come to our dinner that evening.
items.fix: At Navruz last year, my uncle said he might come to our dinner that evening.
items.why: may → might (gap o'tmishda aytilgan).

items.s: The teacher said the Earth goes round the Sun.
items.why: Umumiy haqiqat — backshift shart emas.

16.title: Board Game: He said… She told me…
16.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
16.goal: To'g'ri nutqdagi gapni reported speech'ga aylantirish (backshift, olmosh, vaqt/joy so'zlari), say / tell ni tanlash va oila a'zolari aytgan gaplarni og'zaki yetkazish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qo'shtirnoqdagi gapni qavsdagi boshlanish (He said… / She told me…) bilan TO'LIQ aytadi yoki xatoni tuzatadi.
Guruh tekshiradi: zamon bir qadam orqaga siljidimi, olmosh (I → he/she, my → his/her) va vaqt/joy so'zi (tomorrow → the next day, here → there) o'zgardimi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk' kataklarida said / told bilan kamida 2 ta reported gap aytiladi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Report: "I'm tired." (Aziz said…)
squares.a: Aziz said he was tired.

squares.t: Reported speech: today → ?
squares.a: that day

squares.t: Report: "I live with my grandparents." (She said…)
squares.a: She said she lived with her grandparents.

squares.t: say or tell? He ___ me he was busy.
squares.a: told

squares.t: Reported speech: will → ? / can → ?
squares.a: would / could

squares.t: Report: "I am cooking dinner." (Mum said…)
squares.a: Mum said she was cooking dinner.

squares.t: Reported speech: tomorrow → ?
squares.a: the next day / the following day

squares.t: Correct: She said me she was hungry.
squares.a: She told me she was hungry. / She said she was hungry.

squares.t: Report: "I have two older siblings." (Lola said…)
squares.a: Lola said she had two older siblings.

squares.t: Report: "We have moved to a new flat." (They said…)
squares.a: They said they had moved to a new flat.

squares.t: Reported speech: here → ? / this → ?
squares.a: there / that

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: report what your mum said to you this morning.
squares.a: e.g. My mum said breakfast was ready and I was late for school.

squares.t: Report: "I can speak Russian." (Grandpa said…)
squares.a: Grandpa said he could speak Russian.

squares.t: Report: "I lost my phone yesterday." (Bek said…)
squares.a: Bek said he had lost his phone the day before.

squares.t: Correct: Last year he said he will help me with my homework.
squares.a: Last year he said he would help me with my homework.

squares.t: Report: "I may visit you." (My aunt told me…)
squares.a: My aunt told me she might visit me.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: report two things your grandparents told you.
squares.a: e.g. Grandpa told me that respect for elders was very important.

squares.t: Report: "I was watching TV." (He said…)
squares.a: He said he had been watching TV. (was watching is also OK)

squares.t: Report: "We must respect our elders." (Dad said…)
squares.a: Dad said we had to respect our elders. (must is also OK)

squares.t: Correct: My grandparents told that I was their favourite.
squares.a: My grandparents told me (that) I was their favourite.

squares.t: Report: "I'll see you here tomorrow." (She told me…)
squares.a: She told me she would see me there the next day.

squares.t: Why is there no backshift? She said water boils at 100 degrees.
squares.a: It is a general truth — it is still true now.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: report what a teacher told your class last week.
squares.a: e.g. Our teacher told us the exam would be difficult.

squares.t: Report: "My generation has grown up with smartphones." (He said…)
squares.a: He said his generation had grown up with smartphones.

16.title: Dominoes: direct ↔ reported speech
16.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichida — backshiftni mustahkamlash, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
16.goal: To'g'ri nutqdagi gapni uning reported variantiga ulash: bir xil mazmunli gaplarda zamonni farqlash (live → lived, 'm living → was living, will → would, lived → had lived, can → could, may → might, must → had to).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi qo'shtirnoqli gap (direct speech) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi reported gapga mos keladi — toping.

Ehtiyot bo'ling: ba'zi gaplar deyarli bir xil (I live / I'm living / I will live in Samarkand) — faqat to'g'ri backshift qilingan variant mos keladi. Vaqt so'zlariga ham qarang (tomorrow → the next day).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftlikda zamon qanday o'zgarganini aytadi (Present Simple → Past Simple); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: "I live in Samarkand," she said.
She said she lived in Samarkand.
"I'm living in Samarkand," she said.
She said she was living in Samarkand.
"I will live in Samarkand," she said.
She said she would live in Samarkand.
"I lived in Samarkand as a child," she said.
She said she had lived in Samarkand as a child.
"I can look after my grandpa," he said.
He said he could look after his grandpa.
"I may look after my grandpa," he said.
He said he might look after his grandpa.
"I was looking after my grandpa," he said.
He said he had been looking after his grandpa.
"I'll call you tomorrow," Mum told me.
Mum told me she would call me the next day.
"I called you yesterday," Mum told me.
Mum told me she had called me the day before.
"I'm calling you now," Mum told me.
Mum told me she was calling me then.
"We have visited our ancestors' village," they said.
They said they had visited their ancestors' village.
"We respect our elders," they said.
They said they respected their elders.
"This is my mother tongue," he said.
He said that was his mother tongue.
"I must help my parents here," she said.
She said she had to help her parents there.

16.title: Taboo: family and generations
16.stage: Essential Words 16 (CORE 20) lug'ati o'tilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa)
16.goal: Oila, avlodlar va tarbiya so'zlarini (sibling, upbringing, generation gap, breadwinner, extended family, role model…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Bonus: so'zni topgan o'quvchi tushuntirishni reported speech bilan qaytaradi (Aziz said it was a person who earned money for the family) — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 qo'shimcha ball.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

16.title: Find someone who… was told a family story
16.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa)
16.goal: Ichida reported speech bo'lgan savollarni tuzish (Did your parents say you could…? Did your grandparents tell you they had…?) va javobni sinfga said / told bilan yetkazish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.

O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Did your grandparents tell you they had grown up in a village?'). Savol ichidagi gapda zamon bir qadam orqaga siljiydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va aniq nima deyilganini so'raydi (What exactly did they say?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.

Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni reported speech bilan aytadi: 'Lola told me her grandmother had grown up in Nurata.' Ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …was told as a child that he/she looked like a grandparent.
items.q: When you were a child, did people say you looked like one of your grandparents?

items.t: …has grandparents who said they had grown up in a village.
items.q: Did your grandparents tell you they had grown up in a village?

items.t: …once told his/her parents that he/she would study harder.
items.q: Did you ever tell your parents that you would study harder?

items.t: …was told by a teacher that his/her handwriting was beautiful.
items.q: Did a teacher ever tell you that your handwriting was beautiful?

items.t: …has parents who said his/her grandparents spoilt him/her.
items.q: Did your parents say that your grandparents spoilt you?

items.t: …told a friend last week that he/she was very busy.
items.q: Did you tell a friend last week that you were very busy?

items.t: …has an older sibling who said he/she would help with homework.
items.q: Did your older brother or sister say they would help you with homework?

items.t: …was told by a grandparent that respect for elders was important.
items.q: Did your grandparents tell you that respect for elders was important?

items.t: …has a parent who said the internet had changed family life.
items.q: Did your mum or dad say that the internet had changed family life?

items.t: …said at breakfast today that he/she was tired.
items.q: Did you say at breakfast today that you were tired?

items.t: …has parents who said he/she could stay up late at the weekend.
items.q: Did your parents say you could stay up late at the weekend?

items.t: …has relatives who said they might visit this month.
items.q: Did any of your relatives say they might visit you this month?

16.title: Speaking cards: family stories in reported speech
16.stage: Sinf mashqlaridagi 'IELTS Speaking — Family' mashqi o'rniga yoki dars oxirida (12 daqiqa)
16.goal: Oila va avlodlar mavzusida IELTS Speaking uslubida javob berish: oila a'zolari aytgan gaplarni said / told + backshift bilan yetkazish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: javob + sabab + misol (IELTS uslubi).
Javobda kamida 2 ta reported gap bo'lishi shart (My grandfather told me that he had…, My mum said she would…).
Tinglovchi har bir to'g'ri reported gapni sanaydi (+1 ball): zamon siljimasa yoki 'said me' deyilsa — ball berilmaydi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

16.goal: Reported speech gaplarida (said / told + kimga, zamon siljishi, olmosh o'zgarishi) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.

16.title: Memory: direct → reported (time words and verbs)
16.stage: Keyingi dars boshida (Kahoot'dan keyin) yoki 'Vaqt va joy so'zlari' mashqidan oldin takror sifatida (10 daqiqa)
16.goal: To'g'ri nutqdagi so'zni reported speech'dagi juftiga ulash: now → then, yesterday → the day before, will → would, must → had to, have done → had done va h.k.
rules: Kartalarni qirqib, aralashtiring va teskari qilib stolga 4–6 qator qilib tering.
Navbati kelgan o'quvchi 2 ta kartani ochadi. Direct so'z va uning reported jufti chiqsa (yesterday — the day before) — juftlikni o'ziga oladi.
Juftlikni saqlab qolish uchun shu juft bilan bitta reported gap aytadi: 'Aziz said he had seen Lola the day before.' Gap xato bo'lsa — kartalar joyiga qaytariladi.
Juft chiqmasa — kartalar yana yopiladi, navbat keyingi o'quvchiga o'tadi.
Hamma kartalar tugaganda eng ko'p juftlik yig'gan o'quvchi g'olib.

17.title: Grammar Auction: asked if… / asked where…
17.stage: YANGI MAVZU (reported questions jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
17.goal: Reported savol to'g'ri yoki xato tuzilganini ajratish: Yes/No → asked + if/whether + ega + fe'l; Wh- → asked + wh-so'z + ega + fe'l (darak tartibi); do/did va '?' tushadi, zamon siljiydi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz tarix mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: reported savol to'g'ri tuzilganmi yoki xatomi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: xatoni aniq aytishi kerak (masalan: 'did tushadi, darak tartibi: where + I + had found').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

17.title: Board Game: He asked if… / She asked where…
17.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
17.goal: Savollarni og'zaki reported speech'ga aylantirish (if/whether, wh-so'z + darak tartibi, backshift), xatoni tuzatish va reported savolni asl savolga qaytarish; tarix so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolni to'liq reported gap qilib aytadi (masalan: 'She asked me where I lived.').
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: do/did tushdimi, so'z tartibi darakmi, zamon siljidimi (do → V2, did → had V3, will → would)? Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Make it direct' kataklarida reported gapni asl savolga qaytaradi (savol tartibi va '?' bilan).
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

17.title: Dominoes: direct question ↔ reported question
17.goal: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savolni o'zining reported shakli bilan ulash: if/whether yoki wh-so'z, darak tartibi, zamon siljishi (do → V2, did → had V3, will → would, can → could).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol qaysi toshdagi reported gapga mos kelishini toping va ulang.
Diqqat: o'xshash toshlar bor ('Do you like history?' va 'What do you like about history?'; 'Is the museum open?' va 'Where is the museum?') — if/whether yoki wh-so'zga qarab tanlang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

He asked if I liked history.

The tourist asked where the museum was.

She asked whether I had read the chronicle.

He asked what I liked about history.
"Why did the empire decline?" they asked.
They asked why the empire had declined.

I asked the expert if he could date that coin.

He asked who had written that manuscript.

We asked if the museum would reopen soon.

The professor asked what I was studying.

The child asked how old the walls were.
"Is the artefact authentic?" the buyer asked.
The buyer asked whether the artefact was authentic.

She asked when the Samanids had ruled Bukhara.
"Which sources did you use?" the teacher asked us.
The teacher asked us which sources we had used.

17.title: Taboo: history and civilisation
17.stage: Essential Words 17 (CORE 20) lug'ati o'tilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa)
17.goal: Tarix, sivilizatsiya va bilim mavzusidagi so'zlarni (dynasty, artefact, heritage, manuscript, Silk Road…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol orqali tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Misol keltirish mumkin (masalan, dynasty uchun: 'The Samanids and the Timurids were two of them.'). O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Bonus: topgan o'quvchi shu so'z bilan reported savol aytsa +1 ball (masalan: 'The guide asked who had built the mausoleum.').
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

17.title: Find someone who… has been to Khiva
17.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa)
17.goal: Tarix mavzusida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol berib, keyin uni reported speech bilan aytib berish: I asked Aziz if he had been to Khiva / which century Temur had lived in.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever been to Khiva?).
'Yes' degan (yoki to'g'ri javob bergan) odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha Wh- savol beradi (When did you go there?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi.
Yakun: har o'quvchi 2 ta natijani reported qilib aytadi: 'I asked Dilnoza if she had been to Khiva, and she said she had.' Ustoz so'z tartibi va backshiftni tekshiradi.

17.title: Speaking cards: history questions — ask and report
17.stage: Sinf mashqlaridagi 'Tarix intervyusi' o'rniga yoki dars oxirida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
17.goal: Tarix, meros va muzeylar haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; eshitgan savolni reported speech bilan aytib berish (I asked her which… / if…).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. A o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni B ga beradi.
B kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi (sabab va misol bilan).
Keyin A savolni va javobni reported qilib aytadi: 'I asked Bekzod which historical place he had visited, and he said…'. To'g'ri reported savol — +1 ball.
'Report…' deb yozilgan kartalarda javob beruvchining o'zi savollarni reported qiladi (masalan: 'My mum asked me where I had been.'). Har to'g'ri gap — +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

17.goal: Reported savolda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: asked / wanted to know / wondered + if/whether yoki wh-so'z + ega + fe'l (savol tartibi emas).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Esda tuting: wh-so'z yoki if/whether dan keyin — avval ega, keyin fe'l.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa jamoa qayta teradi.
Bonus: jamoa gapning asl savolini aytsa (masalan: 'Have you been to Bukhara?') yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Grammar Auction: told me to / not to / suggested -ing
18.stage: YANGI MAVZU (buyruq, taqiq, maslahat jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
18.goal: Reported buyruq, taqiq va maslahat to'g'ri yoki xato tuzilganini ajratish: told/asked/advised + kimga + (not) to V1; suggested + V-ing; offered/refused + to V1 (ob'ektsiz).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz rahbarlik va jamoa ishi mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: qoidani ham aytishi kerak (masalan: 'to tushib qolgan: told me TO finish').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

18.title: Dominoes: direct speech ↔ told / advised / suggested
18.goal: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapni reported shakli bilan ulash: buyruq → told to, taqiq → not to, iltimos → asked, maslahat → advised, taklif → suggested + V-ing, va'da/rad → promised/refused to.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap qaysi toshdagi reported gapga mos kelishini toping va ulang.
Diqqat: o'xshash toshlar bor ('Pass the ball' va 'Don't pass the ball'; 'Please help me' va 'I'll help you') — reporting fe'l va 'not' ga qarab tanlang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

The coach told me not to pass the ball.

The doctor advised him to rest.

My colleague asked me to help him.

The manager refused to resign.

The mentor encouraged me to take the initiative.

The captain ordered us to stop talking and listen.

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.

rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.

Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa jamoa qayta teradi.
Bonus: jamoa gapning asl (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri) shaklini aytsa (masalan: 'Don't be late for training!') yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.title: Grammar Auction: look after, look it up, look forward to
19.stage: YANGI MAVZU (LOOK jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
19.goal: LOOK phrasal verblarida to'g'ri zarrachani tanlash (after / for / into / up to / down on / over), ajraladigan fe'lda olmosh o'rnini (look it up) va 'look forward to + V-ing' qoidasini tekshirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz adabiyot va san'at mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: LOOK fe'li to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: zarrachani yoki olmosh o'rnini to'g'rilab, qoidani aytadi (masalan: 'olmosh o'rtada — look it up').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I'm looking for a good anthology of Uzbek poetry.
items.why: look for — qidirmoq; ajralmaydi, ob'ekt zarrachadan keyin.

items.s: If you don't know the word 'metaphor', look up it in the dictionary.
items.fix: If you don't know the word 'metaphor', look it up in the dictionary.
items.why: look up ajraladi: olmosh FAQAT o'rtada — look it up.

items.s: We are looking forward to visit the new art exhibition.

items.why: look forward to — 'to' predlog, keyin V-ing: visiting.

items.s: Many young poets look up to Cho'lpon.

items.s: Could you look my essay over before I send it to the editor?

items.s: The museum staff are looking the missing manuscript for.

items.why: look for ajralmaydi: ob'ekt 'for' dan keyin keladi.

items.s: Real artists never look down to other people's work.

items.why: Mensimaslik — look down ON ('to' emas).

items.s: When I look back on my school years, I remember our poetry club.
items.why: look back on + o'tmish — eslamoq, o'tmishga nazar solmoq.

items.fix: I really look up to my grandmother — she knows hundreds of poems by heart.
items.why: Hurmat qilmoq — look up TO: 'to' tushib qolmaydi (look up — lug'atdan qidirmoq).

items.s: The police are looking into the theft of the famous portrait.
items.why: look into — tekshirmoq (tergov qilmoq); ajralmaydi.

items.s: My grandmother looks after for my little sister after school.

items.why: look after — bitta zarracha; 'for' ortiqcha.

items.s: Look out! That heavy picture is about to fall off the wall!
items.why: Look out! — Ehtiyot bo'l! (xavf haqida ogohlantirish).

19.title: Board Game: look for, look after, look it up
19.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
19.goal: LOOK phrasal verblarini og'zaki ishlatish: zarrachani topish, olmoshni to'g'ri joyga qo'yish (look it over), xatoni tuzatish va adabiyot mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: zarrachani aytadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki LOOK fe'li bilan to'liq gap tuzadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan (javoblar varag'idan) so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' va 'Ask' kataklarida o'yinchi kamida 2 gap aytadi va kamida bitta LOOK phrasal verbni to'g'ri ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

19.title: Dominoes: LOOK phrasal verb ↔ meaning
19.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichida — fe'l ma'nolarini mustahkamlash, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa)
19.goal: 11 ta LOOK phrasal verbni inglizcha ma'nosi bilan ulash va ajraladigan / ajralmaydigan fe'l qoidasini (look it up, look after her, look forward to + V-ing) takrorlash.

Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.

a noun or a verb + -ing.

20.title: Grammar Auction: get over, get along with, get rid of
20.stage: YANGI MAVZU (GET jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
20.goal: GET phrasal verblarida to'g'ri zarracha va predlogni tanlash: get out of (taksi) / get off (avtobus), get over + ot, get along WITH, get rid OF, get down TO, get away WITH.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz munosabatlar va matonat mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: GET fe'li to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: yetishmagan yoki ortiqcha predlogni aytib, qoidani tushuntiradi (masalan: 'get rid OF').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi phrasal verb'ga mos inglizcha ta'rif qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.

21.title: Find someone who… takes after their dad

21.goal: TAKE phrasal verb'lari bilan savol tuzish va javob berish: Do you take after…? Have you taken up…? Did you take to…? Have you ever watched a rocket take off?
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzadi (masalan: '…has taken up a new hobby' → 'Have you taken up a new hobby this year?').
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What? When? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; savol noto'g'ri tuzilsa (masalan, 'Do you take after to…?'), ism hisoblanmaydi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni to'liq gap bilan aytadi (Aziz takes after his dad).

22.title: Grammar Auction: make up, make up for, make of
22.stage: YANGI MAVZU (make jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: MAKE phrasal verb'lari to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish: make up (with yo'q) / make up FOR, make INTO, make OF, make do WITH, make off with, make for.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: make up for, make do with, make off with, make of — predlogi tushib qolmaydi va almashmaydi.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zarracha/predlog to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa (masalan, 'make about' → 'make of') +50 oladi; ustoz izohni (why) o'qib beradi.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

22.goal: MAKE phrasal verb'lari bilan savol tuzish va javob berish: Have you ever made up…? Can you make out…? Have you had to make do with…? Do you think … makes for…?
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzadi (masalan: '…has made up an excuse' → 'Have you ever made up an excuse to miss a lesson?').

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; predlog tushib qolsa yoki almashsa (make up the mistake, make do by…), ism hisoblanmaydi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni to'liq gap bilan aytadi (Lola once made up an excuse…).

23.title: Grammar Auction: turn it off, turn out to be, turn into
23.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (TURN jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
23.goal: TURN phrasal verblarini to'g'ri ishlatish: olmosh o'rni (turn it off), ortiqcha olmosh, turn out TO BE, turn INTO, turn up (kelmoq), turn in (topshirmoq); xato gapni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga eslatma yozing: turn + it + off (olmosh o'rtada); turn out TO BE; turn INTO.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zarracha to'g'ri tanlanganmi (on/off/up/down/into/in…) va olmosh to'g'ri joydami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'turned off it' → 'turned it off').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Please turn off the lights when you leave the research station.
items.why: turn off + ob'ekt — o'chirmoq; ot zarrachadan keyin ham, oldin ham kelishi mumkin.

items.s: The camera was still recording, so the scientist turned off it.
items.fix: The camera was still recording, so the scientist turned it off.
items.why: Olmosh (it) zarrachadan oldin keladi: turn it off.

items.s: The government turned down the plan to build a road through the national park.
items.why: turn down + taklif/reja — rad etmoq.

items.s: The story about the poachers turned out be true.
items.fix: The story about the poachers turned out to be true.
items.why: …bo'lib chiqdi — turn out TO BE; 'to' tushib qolmaydi.

items.s: The old factory was turned into a wildlife sanctuary.
items.why: turn X into Y — aylantirmoq; passivda: was turned into.

items.s: In a few weeks, the caterpillar turned to a beautiful butterfly.
items.fix: In a few weeks, the caterpillar turned into a beautiful butterfly.
items.why: Aylanmoq — turn INTO (turn to emas).

items.s: Only five volunteers turned up to plant trees on Saturday.
items.why: turn up — (tadbirga) kelmoq; ob'ektsiz.

items.s: The documentary was so good that I turned the volume up it.
items.fix: The documentary was so good that I turned the volume up.
items.why: Ortiqcha olmosh: ob'ekt bitta bo'ladi — the volume YOKI it.

items.s: Bad weather made the climbers turn back before they reached the top.
items.why: turn back — orqaga qaytmoq; ob'ektsiz.

items.s: He turned on late for the conservation meeting.
items.fix: He turned up late for the conservation meeting.
items.why: Kelmoq — turn up; turn on — yoqmoq.

items.s: Local people turned against the dam because it damaged the river's ecosystem.
items.why: turn against + kim/nima — qarshi chiqmoq; ajralmaydi.

items.s: Students must turn on their field research reports by Friday.
items.fix: Students must turn in their field research reports by Friday.
items.why: Topshirmoq (hisobot, uy vazifasi) — turn in; turn on — yoqmoq.

23.title: Board Game: turn it up or turn it down?
23.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin gapirish mashqi sifatida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
23.goal: TURN phrasal verblarini og'zaki ishlatish: zarrachani tanlash, olmosh o'rni, ma'nodan fe'lni topish, xatoni tuzatish va tabiat mavzusida qisqa gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: faqat zarrachani emas, to'liq gapni aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa javob kalitiga yoki ustozga murojaat qilinadi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida bitta TURN phrasal verb ishlatish shart, aks holda o'yinchi joyida qoladi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida ibora bor (masalan: 'turn on the night camera'). Chap tomonida shu iboraning ma'nosi yozilgan toshni topib, ulang.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.
Qo'shimcha topshiriq: har guruh 3 ta iborani o'z gapida ishlatib, sinfga aytadi.

rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga eslatma yozing: set out TO + V1; winter sets IN; set + it + off; be set against + OT.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zarracha to'g'rimi (off/up/in/out/aside…), olmosh o'rnidami, ortiqcha so'z yo'qmi?

24.title: Dominoes: SET phrasal verbs and their meanings

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi va sinfdoshidan so'raydi (masalan: '…sets aside some money every month' → 'Do you set aside some money every month?').

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Savol faqat inglizcha, SET phrasal verb to'g'ri shaklda bo'lishi shart.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytadi (masalan: 'Jasur has set up a Telegram channel.').

squares.a: take off (The plane took off.)

squares.t: Tell us one thing you often put off. Why?
squares.a: e.g. I often put off cleaning my room because it's boring.

squares.t: Use a phrasal verb: They delayed the meeting.
squares.a: They put off the meeting. / They put the meeting off.

squares.t: Which verb? She ___ over the flu in a week.
squares.a: got (get over — recover from)

squares.t: Correct: Don't put down them — they're doing their best!
squares.a: Don't put them down — they're doing their best!

squares.t: Use a phrasal verb: He tolerates his noisy brother.
squares.a: He puts up with his noisy brother.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how much effort have you put in this term?
squares.a: e.g. I've put in a lot of effort: 25 lessons and 20 essays.

squares.t: Which phrasal verb means 'start a company'?
squares.a: set up (They set up a company.) / also: start up

squares.t: Use a phrasal verb: She saved some money for her studies.
squares.a: She put some money aside for her studies. (also: put away / set aside)

squares.t: Which verb? She ___ down the job offer because the pay was low.
squares.a: turned (turn down — refuse)

squares.t: Ask your partner a question with 'put up with'.
squares.a: e.g. What can't you put up with at school?

squares.t: Use a phrasal verb: He explained his ideas clearly.
squares.a: He put his ideas across clearly. (also: got … across — L20)

squares.t: Report it: 'Don't put off your revision,' the teacher told us.
squares.a: The teacher told us not to put off our revision.

squares.t: Emphasis: Oybek wrote 'Navoiy' during the war. (It was … who …)
squares.a: It was Oybek who wrote 'Navoiy' during the war.

squares.t: Finish: The more effort you put in, …
squares.a: e.g. …the higher your band score will be.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds about your future plans — use 3 PUT verbs.
squares.a: e.g. I'll put money aside, put in more hours and put together a good CV.

25.title: Dominoes: phrasal verbs and their meanings
25.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' o'rnida (PUT fe'llari o'tilgandan keyin) yoki dars oxirida: PUT + look / get / take / turn / set takrori (12 daqiqa)
25.goal: Gapdagi phrasal verbni ma'nosi bilan ulash: PUT bilan 11 fe'l (put on / off / out / up with / up / in / through / across / aside / together / down) va kurs takrori (look up to, get over, take after, turn down, set up).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gapda qaysi phrasal verb bor — shu fe'lning ma'nosi ('= …') yozilgan toshni topib, ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Diqqat: 11 ta gap PUT bilan, 5 tasi kursdagi look / get / take / turn / set bilan.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (gap + ma'nosi); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus: 3 ta fe'l bilan o'z gapini aytgan guruh +1.

pairs: It's freezing, so put your jacket on.
= start wearing it
The boss was ill, so they put the meeting off.
= moved it to a later date
The fire was small, and they put it out quickly.
= stopped it burning
I can't put up with this noise any more.
= tolerate something unpleasant
We put up posters about the school concert.
= fixed them on walls for people to see
She put in six months of hard work.
= spent time and energy on a task
Can you put me through to the manager?
= connect my phone call to someone
He put his ideas across very clearly.
= explained them so people understood
I put some money aside every month.
= save it for the future
She put together a team of five students.
= formed a group from different people
Don't put your classmates down.
= criticise them and make them feel stupid
I really look up to my grandfather.
= respect and admire him
She got over the flu in a week.
= recovered from an illness
He takes after his father.
= is similar to a parent in looks or character
She turned the job offer down.
= refused it
They set up a small business in 2020.
= started a company

25.title: Taboo: education, ambition and the future
25.stage: 'Education, ambition and the future — CORE 20' lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa)
25.goal: Essential Words 25 so'zlarini (ambition, scholarship, degree, deadline, procrastination, tuition fees, mentor…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish: ta'rif, sinonim, misol.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda PUT phrasal verblarini ishlatish mumkin va foydali (masalan: 'When you put off your work…') — kartada taqiqlangan bo'lmasa.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi va raqib +1 ball oladi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

25.title: Find someone who… puts money aside every month
25.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq, Reading bosqichidan oldin (10 daqiqa)
25.goal: PUT phrasal verblari (put aside, put off, put up, put up with, put on, put together, put in, put down) va kursdagi look up to, look forward to, turn down bilan savol tuzish va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you put money aside every month?). Zarracha va zamon to'g'ri bo'lishi shart.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What for? / Why? / When?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni reported speech bilan aytib beradi (masalan: Aziz said he put money aside every month).

items.t: …puts money aside every month.
items.q: Do you put money aside every month?

items.t: …often puts off homework until late at night.
items.q: Do you often put off homework until late at night?

items.t: …has put up a tent in the mountains.
items.q: Have you ever put up a tent in the mountains?

items.t: …can easily put up with a noisy classroom.
items.q: Can you easily put up with a noisy classroom?

items.t: …put on smart clothes for the placement test.
items.q: Did you put on smart clothes for the placement test?

items.t: …has put together a study plan for university entrance exams.
items.q: Have you put together a study plan for university entrance exams?

items.t: …wants to put in an application for a scholarship.
items.q: Do you want to put in an application for a scholarship?

items.t: …has put his/her goals down on paper.
items.q: Have you put your goals down on paper?

items.t: …has put his/her phone aside for a whole day.
items.q: Have you ever put your phone aside for a whole day?

items.t: …looks up to a teacher or a mentor.
items.q: Do you look up to a teacher or a mentor?

items.t: …is looking forward to studying abroad.
items.q: Are you looking forward to studying abroad?

items.t: …has turned down an invitation this month.
items.q: Have you turned down an invitation this month?

25.title: Speaking cards: education, ambition and the future
25.stage: Sinf mashqlaridagi 'Final Speaking mashqi' o'rnida yoki Listening'dan keyin — juftlikda, IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida (12 daqiqa)
25.goal: Ta'lim, maqsad va kelajak mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; javobda PUT phrasal verblari va kursdagi grammatika (reported speech, emphasis, the more …, the …) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 1 ta PUT phrasal verb ishlatadi (put off, put up with, put in, put aside…).
Tinglovchi ball beradi: har bir to'g'ri PUT phrasal verb +1, kursdagi boshqa grammatika (reported speech, It was … who, the more …, the …) +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; eng yaxshi 2 javob sinfga aytiladi.

cards: What do you usually put off? Why do you put it off, and what happens then?
What can't you put up with when you are studying at home?
How much effort have you put in this term? What was the hardest part?
Do you put any money aside? What are you saving for?
What do you put on for an important exam or an interview? Why?
Have you ever put together a team or a plan for a project? How did it go?
Is it easy for you to put your ideas across in English? Why or why not?
What should a teacher do when students put each other down?
Which teacher or mentor do you look up to? Why?
What are you looking forward to doing after this course? Why?
Would you like to study abroad? What would you have to put up with there?
Should universities put up their tuition fees? Why or why not?
Oybek put up with serious illness but never stopped writing. What can students learn from him?
'The more effort you put in, the higher your band score.' Do you agree? Why?
What did your teacher tell you to do before the final test? Report it.
What is your biggest ambition? What will you have to put aside to achieve it?

25.title: Sentence Race: PUT phrasal verbs in the right order
25.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa)
25.goal: Phrasal verbli gapda so'z tartibi: olmosh o'rtada (put it out, put them down, put us up), put up with va put off + V-ing ajralmaydi; kurs takrori (turned it down, the more …, the …).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Eslatma: olmosh (it, them, us, me) fe'l va zarracha o'rtasida turadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa — qayta teradi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — birinchi tugatgan jamoa.

sentences: I can't put up with my noisy neighbours.
Many students put off revising until the night before the exam.
A small fire started, but the students put it out.
Can you put me through to the admissions office, please?
Your classmates are trying their best, so don't put them down.
We have nowhere to stay, so could you put us up?
I have good ideas, but I can't put them across.
The meeting has been put off until next Monday.
The university offered her a place, but she turned it down.
The more effort you put in, the higher your band score.

25.title: Quiz Board: PUT, course revision and education
25.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy kurs takrori yoki final testdan oldingi dars boshida, Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
25.goal: PUT phrasal verblari, kursdagi look / get / take / turn fe'llari, ta'lim so'zlari (Essential Words 25) va kurs grammatikasini (reported speech, emphasis, the more …, the …) o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: It's cold outside. Put ___ your coat.
She puts some money ___ every month for a new laptop.
Can you put me ___ to the manager, please?
Which verb? I ___ up to my grandfather: he is my hero.
Which verb? He ___ after his father: same eyes, same smile.
Here's your scarf. Put on it!
qs.a: Here's your scarf. Put it on!

qs.q: I can't put up this noise.
qs.a: I can't put up with this noise.

qs.q: He put on a lot of effort.
qs.a: He put in a lot of effort.

qs.q: They put off to meet until Monday.
qs.a: They put off meeting until Monday.

qs.q: The offer was good, but she turned down it.
The last day to finish your work or send it in.
The money you pay a university for your course.
Money given to a good student to pay for their studies.
An experienced, trusted adviser who helps a younger person grow over a long time (m…).
The habit of always leaving your work until later.
Say what you put on when it's cold outside.
qs.a: e.g. I put on a warm coat and a hat.

qs.q: Tell us one thing you can't put up with at school.
qs.a: e.g. I can't put up with noise during tests.

qs.q: Report it: 'I will put money aside,' Madina said.
qs.a: Madina said (that) she would put money aside.

qs.q: Make it emphatic: I need a scholarship. (What I …)
qs.a: What I need is a scholarship.

qs.q: Join with 'the more …, the …': you revise / you feel confident.
qs.a: The more you revise, the more confident you feel.
